question: Does WMI message-ID handling live in the unexamined wpss segments b09/b10/b12 of the WCN6750 firmware?
tool: tools/wmi_b091012_scan.py (reuses F-20 sweep+pattern_search verbatim; capstone RV32+C resync sweep; xref_wmi 605 IDs; mdt phdr ground truth)

mdt_header_ground_truth.e_machine_note: 164=EM_QDSP6 (Qualcomm Hexagon) - confirms F-7 junk-field finding; entry 0x9bb00000
mdt_header_ground_truth.note: Only b01/b02/b03/b05/b06 carry PF_X. b07/b08 (F-20's targets) are RW data segments. b09/b10 RW data; b12 is a PT_NULL hash/cert region.

b09.note: Raw payload (unlike b07/b08 which are standalone ELFs). RW data segment, memsz 14.8 MB vs filesz 361 KB = mostly zero-fill (60.9% zero bytes in file).

rv32_sweep.dominated_by: c.unimp x94128 (resync filler) => data, not code
rv32_sweep.construction_hits_verdict: noise (data sweep), same class as F-20's rodata noise

eh_frame.note: clean u32-length chain 1,072 B then content changes role; FDE pc_begin sdata4-pcrel values decode into b06 exec range (~0xC04E6BD0-0xC04E6CB0)

id_registry_table.record_shape: 12-byte stride [ptr, id, 0]; ptr in 0xc0000000-0xc2000000 (b06 exec range); id grp<<12|cmd
id_registry_table.self_vaddr_note: 0xc0691080 = vaddr of the main run itself; registry nodes link to each other
id_registry_table.verdict: WMI-shaped message-ID registry with code-range pointers: dispatch DATA found (unlike F-20's b07/b08). IDs numerically overlap ath11k wmi.h IDs (shared grp<<12|cmd space); name strings are firmware-internal WHAL_/WAL_ enums.

unidentified_adjacent_records.shape: [x, ptr, id, hash-like-word] or [id, hash, ...]; pairs WMI-shaped ids (0x2001,0x200a,0x200b,0x1005,0x1008,0x2115,0x4011,0x401a...) with random-looking 32-bit words (CRC-like)
unidentified_adjacent_records.verdict: unidentified; broader message system (diag/QuRT?) - honest unknown

b10.note: RW data segment; 95.5% of file is ASCII
b10.role: format-string/trace table for the b06 code: 'file.c:...' QCA style (wal_*.c, whal_*.c, wmi_ftm_attach.c, memheap.c, platform_diag_pmon.c)

wmi_name_examples: wmi_ftm_attach.c:ERROR: ftm_parse_unifiedcmd: dataLen %d is LESS than sizeof(segHdrInfo) %d

u16_hits.verdict: noise; top 0x5020 x449 = ASCII ' P' in text

b10.verdict: NO ID tables; role = trace/format strings

b12.note: PT_NULL hash/cert region; not a normal LOAD
b12.content: X.509 DER certificate chain: DER SEQUENCE headers at 0x3f8/0x653/0x8f3; strings: 'Generated OEM Root CA', 'Fairphone BV', 'T2MO OEM Key', 'Amsterdam', 'SecTools', 'Generated OEM Attestation CA', validity '250305073959Z'->'450228073959Z'
b12.verdict: Secure-boot cert chain (production), independently confirms librephone-upstream docs/wpss.b12.md. NO code, NO WMI content. Closed.

verdict.wmi_id_handling_in_wpss: YES - table-driven, in b09 (data) + b10 (trace strings); handler code in b06 (RWX, 6.07 MB main code segment)
verdict.explains_F20: F-20's zero on b07 is fully explained: b07/b08 are RW data segments (PF_X absent per mdt); construction-site hunting was the wrong instrument because dispatch is not arithmetic - IDs are stored in a static registry
verdict.remaining_unknown: exact b06 consumer of the registry (cross-ref vaddr 0xc0691080+ from b06 code) - future work
verdict.segments_closed: b07 (F-20), b08 (F-20), b09 (F-21: registry data, no code), b10 (F-21: strings), b12 (F-21: certs)

prior_art: none found (GitHub code/repo search 2026-11-11, per F-20); extends F-20
